rna.text: Reza, a young vedalken Azorius lawmage, is urged by his mentor Tagan to visit the Historical Archives in person, and he agrees despite his fear of flying, but lightning hits a thopter and he falls into a pile of trash in the Thinktank.
Stranded there, he is helped by Hendrik and Janin, but a mugger steals his satchel, and without his identity rune he flees the Azorius arresters, fearing arrest under his own new law.

Hendrik and Janin rescue him, and Reza realizes Hendrik is the mad genius shooting down thopters, so he invokes emergency law to name Hendrik Grand Arbiter pro tem and grants the Thinktank sovereignty so it can request Azorius help.
After months of negotiation, Reza solves the Thinktank Jurisdictional Fallacy, and Tagan tells him she can no longer be his mentor because it is time he became one himself.
